# terrakube_output (Ephemeral Resource)

Reads the outputs of the latest run of a workspace without storing them in plan or state. Use it instead of the `terrakube_output` data source when the outputs include secrets. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later, or OpenTofu 1.11 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the outputs of another workspace without storing them in plan or state.
ephemeral "terrakube_output" "network" {
  organization = "acme"
  workspace    = "network"
}

variable "organization_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "workspace_id" {
  type = string
}

# Pass a sensitive output straight to a write-only argument.
resource "terrakube_workspace_variable" "db_password" {
  organization_id  = var.organization_id
  workspace_id     = var.workspace_id
  key              = "db_password"
  value_wo         = ephemeral.terrakube_output.network.values.db_password
  value_wo_version = 1
  description      = "Database password read from the network workspace"
  category         = "TERRAFORM"
  sensitive        = true
  hcl              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization Name
- `workspace` (String) Workspace Name

### Read-Only

- `nonsensitive_values` (Dynamic) Values of the workspace outputs that are not marked sensitive. Null when the workspace has no runs yet.
- `values` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Values of all the workspace outputs, including sensitive ones. Null when the workspace has no runs yet.
